svg.aria-label: Isometric model of an offline community radio and TV network on a plinth: a ministry control centre with a wall of screens and a map table (the author's proposal), an ANE spectrum monitoring station, a transmission pole with a broadcast whip, a cabinet of general-purpose computers with an SDR, a SENA classroom with a screen and learners, and three rural homes with a phone and a radio. The internet cable is cut: it is optional.
